title: Phoolan Devi
summary: Phoolan Devi was born in 1963 into a Mallah boatman family at Gorha Ka Purwa in Jalaun, Uttar Pradesh. Married as a child, she later took control of a bandit gang in the Chambal Valley, surrendered in 1983 and was jailed for 11 years without trial. Elected to parliament for Mirzapur in 1996, she was shot dead outside her official residence in New Delhi on 25 July 2001.

uncertainty.note: Birth is 10 August 1963 in MediaIndia; TheCollector gives only 1963.

reviewer_note: Both sources are popular web articles, not scholarly or archival. The surrender date differs (12 Feb in TheCollector; month missing in MediaIndia), so only the year 1983 is used. The pin is the Wikidata point for Jalaun district because the village Gorha Ka Purwa could not be located on an opened page; uncertainty set to 60 km. The 1981 Behmai episode is described as disputed by TheCollector and is left out.
